joanne_docs: opened PR to rework the 429/timeouts troubleshooting page. goal: add two compact patterns for SDK users + a short runbook. PTAL.

ben_sdk: please include a tiny JS example that shows: on 429 -> backoff+jitter -> try smaller model -> if still 429, abridge conversation and retry. keep sample <10 lines.

kai_oncall: call out recommended backoff: base 200ms, multiplier 2, jitter random(0,100ms), max attempts 5. note to avoid hammering during outage.

tess_prod: also show fallback order: 1) route to smaller model, 2) abridge oldest assistant/system messages, 3) last-resort trim user context. add telemetry example: incr counter "docs.error.429.fallback".

joanne_docs: will add two samples: "fallbackToVariant" and "abridgePromptForContext". adding a 1-line runbook: "On surge 429s, prefer variant fallback, enable jittered backoff, monitor quality regressions."

docs-bot: checklist: code sample, runbook line, SDK link, minimal unit test.

ben_sdk: naming nit: use `abridgePromptForContext` and comment to preserve last user message. I'll review the snippet.

joanne_docs: pushed changes, included a tiny unit test that asserts abridge keeps last user message. merging after review.

kai_oncall: after merge, tag release notes and incident channels; behavior is user-facing.

tess_prod: i'll draft release blurb. thanks all :thumbsup:
